author: Apple
description:
AirPods Max 2 delivers high-fidelity audio powered by the H2 chip, with up to 1.5x more Active Noise Cancellation than the previous generation. It offers personalized Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking, Live Translation, up to 20 hours of listening time with Active Noise Cancellation, Lossless Audio via USB-C, and is available in five vibrant colors.

#AirPodsMax2 #ActiveNoiseCancellation #LiveTranslation

Up to 1.5x more Active Noise Cancellation than the previous generation when tested in accordance with IEC 60268-24.

Spatial Audio works with compatible content in supported apps. iPhone with TrueDepth camera required to create personalized profile.

Live Translation available on compatible devices with the latest operating system software when paired with compatible AirPods with the latest firmware when Apple Intelligence is turned on. Not available in all languages and regions.

Battery life depends on device settings, environment, usage, and many other factors.
